theorems.name: Submission.lcmp_exists_lipschitz_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (ε : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → 0 < ε → ∃ (ψ : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L ψ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x ∧ ψ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ψ x = 1) ∧ {x | 0 < ψ x} ⊆ thickening ε K ∧ CompactlyContained {x | 0 < ψ x} U
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
